newsitem.title: UK: UK's Knight says data best performance in 10 years.
newsitem.headline: UK's Knight says data best performance in 10 years.

text.p: The British Treasury's economic secretary, Angela Knight, said Thursday's balance of payments data represented the best performance in a decade.
"This is the best trading performance in 10 years. It confirms the UK as a strong international trading country," she said in a statement given by a Treasury official.

The Office for National Statistics (ONS) said Britain had a second quarter current account surplus of 792 million stg, against a previous estimate of a 457 million stg surplus and following a first quarter 1.276 billion deficit.
The ONS also said third quarter gross domestic product was up an unrevised 0.8 percent.
